caseName: Gordon v. New York Stock Exchange, Inc.
caseNameFull: Gordon v. New York Stock Exchange, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 419 U. S. 1018.] Motion of the Solicitor General to permit the United States and the Securities and Exchange Commission to participate in oral argument as amici curiae granted and a total of 40 additional minutes allotted for that purpose.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.*
